generalCriterionList.description: COVER-1 (Technical bid) shall contain the following qualifying conditions/documents
Contractors Registration certificate enrolled under KPWD Active in the period Class IV and Above
The Income tax returns filed duly mentioning PAN No. for the F.Y year 2024-25 assessment year 2025-26

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Employees provident fund EPF registration certificate
A copy of the GST Certificate

COVER II SHALL CONTAIN THE FINANCIAL BID The financial bid documents for the above work comprises of financial bid to indicate the amount of offered by the bidder for completion of the work on percentage basis based on scope of work. Specifications Schedule-A and Schedule-B of the contract form. The contractor should give detailed execution plan and furnish program to complete the work in all respect within the stipulated period of completion. The contractor should neither make any alteration in the conditions of contract nor stipulate any condition of his own.The Cover-I Technical Bid will be opened first and there after Cover-II Financial Bid of only those bidders who fulfill the conditions as mentioned will be opened subject to the condition that the EMD payment is confirmed in the e-portal.The bidder shall ensure credit of tender processing fee in to the respective receiving bank accounts of e-procurement on or before the last date of bid submission.The tenderer is requested to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The department is not being responsible for non-accessibility of e-procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.
NOTES-IIThe intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submission of the tenders
The Contractor bidding for more than one work and his tender accepted for more than one work, will be awarded priority based on emergency work to be taken up as per site condition

If the percentage quoted by contractor for the work is below the amount put to tender (updated cost as per CSR) then the successful contractor shall furnish an additional performance security in the form of Bank Guarantee for minimum period of 1 year, for an amount equivalent to the difference between the cost as per quoted percentage and the amount put to tender (updated cost as per CSR) before executing the agreement. In case of contractor quoting the percentage above One Hundred and ten percent (110 percentage) of the amount put to tender (updated cost as per CSR) then the amount over and above One Hundred and Ten percent (110 percentage) of the amount put to tender (updated cost as per CSR) will be withheld during the progress of work

The necessary certificates / documents in support of eligibility criteria fulfilled as stipulated shall be scanned and attached to e-tender document. The Original certificates/documents shall be produced on or before stipulated date and time for verification. Scanned signature of the bidder/authorized representative of the bidder shall be attached while up loading bid document
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
The contractor will have to make their own arrangements for all the machinery necessary for the works
Corrigendum will be published in web site for all modifications/corrections if any

The intending bidders should note that, if any of lands either in part/parts or whole required for the work is not acquired by the Nigam, it shall be the responsibility of the bidder to take possession of such land and start the work by the consent of the land owners before commencement of work at no extra cost to the Nigam and no claim whatsoever relating to non availability of land would be entertained
The contractor should mention their recent correct postal address, e-mail address and Contact Number in the declaration form
Incomplete tender documents will be rejected

All the materials like steel, cement etc., required for the above work should be procured by the contractor only at his own cost. And these materials will have to be got tested by the competent authority before put to use
The Contractor shall send authorization letter for their representative duly attesting their signature
As per the Karnataka building and other construction workers welfare cess act 1996, 1.00% of the bill amount will be deducted from the bills
Tenders will be opened on the due date in presence of the contractor or their Authorized representatives
The contractors should adhere to the accepted action plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending bill payment of the work
Typo-graphical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor
Tendering by the joint venture will not be allowed
The contractor should furnish the name of the individual /firm with address and Telephone numbers with place of registration, year of incorporation etc
The tender processing charges paid by the bidders are not refundable even if the tenders are cancelled
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders

Regarding deduction of Royalty charges for procurement of all materials required for the work- the guidelines issued by the Director of Mines & Geological Department vide circular No2023-24 07.11.2023 Senior Geologist (Mines) Mines & Geological Department Dharwad Letter No:2818 dated 23.11.2023 Chief Accounts Officer, KNNL, Dharwad vide ltr No. 8708 dated 26.12.2023 are to be strictly followed

The tenderer has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure only ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority, before execution
Sub leasing of work in any form is prohibited

No querries are approved by KNNL for materials. The quarries considered are for the estimate purpose only. The intending bidders shall visit the site, identify the quarries, as certain availability for the quantity and quality of the materials required for the work and shall quote his rates accordingly. No extra claim whatsoever will be entertained in this regard

The rates include all lead and lifts and work shall be carried out as per instruction of Engineer in charge. All specification are as per relevant IS codes in vogue and Indian Road Congress. The rates for the specification in the schedule B includes all lead and lifts irrespective of the distance and height, no extra claim will be entertained for additional lead and lifts

If Nigam wishes to engage third party inspecting agency for the said work, apart from the quality Control authorities and field tests of Nigam, the Contractor should co-operate with the third party and quality control authorities
The Agency should establish field laboratory at his cost with requirement, or as stipulated in the Agreement
The tender inviting authority has got right either accepting tender or rejecting the tender without assigning any reasons
The validity period of EMD shall be for a minimum period of 225 days from the date of opening of the tenders
EMD of unsuccessful bidders will be refunded only after the acceptance of tenders by the competent authority
The amount put to tender is exclusive of GST. The contractor shall quote the rate exclusive of GST
GST shall be paid to the tender amount as per prevailing Government orders

The contractor shall ensure that no mechanical equipment or manual operation damages the canal lining, masonry structures, concrete structures, or embankments during the execution of work. Excavation of silt shall be carried out only to the required level and shall not disturb the original bed profile, canal section, or stability of the banks
The contractor shall follow all instructions issued by the Engineer-in-Charge during the execution of work and ensure proper supervision to avoid any damage to government property

Any negligence leading to damage of canal structures or government property will be the sole responsibility of the contractor, and the cost of repair/reconstruction will be recovered from the contractor
Further information can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, KNNL, No.5 Canal Division, Yermarus Camp during office hours

BID CAPACITY The tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value the available tender Capacity will be calculated as under For Sl No 15Assessed available tender Capacity AxNx2.50-B

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing Vetrified Flooring for SE TCCC Office Yermarus Camp.

itemList.itemCode: PWD SR 2023-24 VOL II ITEM NO 19.29 PG NO 190
itemList.description:
Dismantling jackarch roofing and floors including stacking of serviceable
material anddisposal of unserviceablematerial to theappropriatedisposal
area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.

itemList.itemCode: PWD SR 2023-24, VOL-I, ITEM NO 2.1.4, PG NO 59
itemList.description:
Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all 
works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse 
aggregates 'and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine 'mixed, laid 
in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, 'well compacted using plate 
vibrators, including all 'lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, 
'Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other 'appurtenances 
required to complete the work as per technical specifications. 
Mix 1:3:6 Using 20 mm and down size graded 
crushed coarse aggregates as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.

itemList.itemCode: PWD SR 2023-24, VOL-II, ITEM NO 9.24, PG NO 63
itemList.description:
Providing and laying Polished Granite stone flooring in required design 
and patterns, in linear as well as curvilinear portions of the building all 
complete as per the architectural drawings with 18 mm thick stone slab 
over 20 mm (average) thick base of cement mortar 1:4 (1 cement : 4 
coarse sand) laid and jointed with cement slurry and pointing with white 
cement slurry admixed with pigment of matching shade including rubbing, 
curing and polishing etc. all complete as specified and as directed by the 
Engineer-in-Charge, Polished Granite stone slab Black, Cat Eye, River Pink or equivalent.

itemList.itemCode: PWD SR 2023-24 Vol-II  Item no. 9.12.2 P.No.60
itemList.description:
Providing and laying vitrified floor tiles with thickness 9-10mm in different
sizes with water absorption less than 0.08% and conforming to IS:15622, of
approved make, in all colours and shades, laid on 20mm thick cement mortar
1:4(1 cement:4 coarse sand), jointing with grey cement slurry @3.3kg/m2 
including grouting the joints with white cement and matching pigments etc.,
complete. Size of Tile 600x600 mm as per direction of Engineer in charge.

itemList.itemCode: PWD SR 2023-24 Vol-II  Item no. 9.20.2 P.No.62
itemList.description:
Grouting the joints of flooring tiles having joints of 3 mm width, using epoxy
grout mix of 0.70 kg of organic coated filler of desired shade (0.10kg of
hardener and 0.20 kg of resin per kg), including filling / grouting and
finishing complete as per direction of Engineer-in-charge. Size of Tile 600x600
mm

Providing and fixing nickel plated M.S. pipe curtain rods with nickel plated
brackets (25mm dia heavy pipe) as per direction of Engineer in charge.

Providing & fixing 100% Polyester Curtains with specification of 
regular wash  as per direction of Engineer in charge

itemList.itemCode: PWD SR 2023-24 VOL II ITEM NO 6.32 PG NO 17
itemList.description:
Providing and constructing load bearing wall with Solid Concrete blocks of
size 400x200x200mm having block density more than 1800kg/m3 and
minimum compressive strength of 4.00 N/mm2 conforming to IS 2185 (Part
17 I) 2005 and constructed with CM 1:4 as per IS 2572:2005 including cost of 
all materials, labour, scaffolding and curing, usage charges of machinery etc
complete as per specifications. as per direction of Engineer-in-charge of Work.

itemList.itemCode: PWD SR 2023-24 VOL II ITEM NO-8.5.1. PO NO 42
itemList.description:
Providing 15 mm cement plaster on rough side of single or half brick wall
finished with a floating cont of neat cement of mix 1:3 (1 cement: 3 find sand)
including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing
and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete
as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge

itemList.itemCode: PWD SR 2023-24 VOL II ITEM NO 8.24 PG NO 45
itemList.description:
Distempering with dry distemper of approved brand and manufacture (two
coats) of required shade on new work, over and including water thinnable
priming coat to give an even shade after thoroughly brooming the surface to
remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the
surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as
per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

itemList.itemCode: PWD SR 2023-24 VOL II ITEM NO 20.88 PG NO 206
itemList.description:
Repairs to plaster in patches of 2.5 m2 and less in walls, ceilings 10 to 20mm
thick in cement mortar 1:3 including cutting the patches in proper shape and
replastering the surface of the wall including disposal of rubbish with a lead
of 50m including curing cost of materials, labour, complete as per
specification  as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

itemList.itemCode: PWD ELE SR 2023-24, Page No-31, It No- 6.8.2
itemList.description:
Supplying of...TR Invertor type split Air conditioners suitable for operation on
A/C supply single phase 50 Hz 230 Volts with hermetically sealed inverter
compressor with air cooled condenser, latest R410A / R-32 refrigerant fan
motor, start & run capacitors, relay & over load protector internal unit, with
one indoor & one outdoor unit. The condenser unit will 34 be placed outside
the room avoid noise including standard length of suitable size copper tubing
covered with nitrile rubber insulation tube. suitable capacity 3 core sheathed/
PVC copper cable and a battery operated wireless remote unit. 3 star 1.5 ton
capacity, as per direction of Engineer-in-charge of Work.

itemList.itemCode: PWD ELE SR 2023-24, Page No-32, It No-6.12
itemList.description:
Installation charges for split type air conditioner with allied works for one
indoor and one outdoor unit is to be mounted on suitable Angle Iron 35
support up to 3.0 ton split/cassette type A/C. as per direction of Engineer in
charge of Work.

itemList.itemCode: PWD ELE SR 2023-24, Page No-38, It No- 9.1.1
itemList.description:
Supplying, erecting, testing and commissioning of voltage stabilizer suitable
for 170 to 270 v in put and load variation from no load to full load, 36 with
over load protection, spike suppression, operating at 00 C to 400 C. Range
etc., complete. 3KVA Capacity. as per direction of Engineer-in-charge of Work.
